title: Futu to Hold Hong Kong's Largest Investment and Wealth Expo for the Third Consecutive Year, One-Stop Wealth Partner Bringing Together Global Financial Wisdom to Decode Investment Opportunities
summary: Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited ("Futu") today announced that the third edition of the Futu Investment Exhibition ("Futu Expo"), Hong Kong's largest investment and wealth expo[1], will take place on 13-14 March at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre. Since launching in 2024, the Expo has become the city's premier annual investment event designed exclusively for retail investors, and the only free-admission exhibition of its scale in Hong Kong.
